title.zh: 本週追蹤：AI 晶片供給要同時看 CoWoS、HBM 與後段測試
title.en: Weekly follow-up: AI chip supply depends on CoWoS, HBM and backend testing

summary.zh: 台積電 10 月 15 日法說表示，5 倍光罩尺寸的 CoWoS 已量產；同日美光台中 AATT2 先進封裝測試廠開幕，支援 HBM。這兩項是本週進展，今日整合追蹤，並無新增產能數字。
summary.en: TSMC said on October 15 that its five-reticle CoWoS platform was in production. Micron opened its Taichung AATT2 advanced assembly and test facility for HBM the same day. These are weekly follow-ups; no new capacity figures are established today.

text.zh: AI 設計需求先進入晶圓製造，再由封裝整合邏輯晶片與 HBM，經測試後交給伺服器廠。晶圓、記憶體及封裝任一環節的良率或交期，都可能限制最終交付；各廠擴產公告不能直接相加成可用系統。
text.en: AI designs move through wafer fabrication, packaging with HBM, testing and server assembly. Yield or delivery constraints at any layer can limit systems output; announced expansions cannot simply be added together.

text.zh: HBM 連結加速器封裝，伺服器 DRAM 連結系統記憶體，NAND 與企業 SSD 則連結儲存。TrendForce 9 月 30 日研究描述伺服器與企業 SSD 需求較強、消費端採購審慎，屬背景與預測，不能推成所有記憶體供應商同步增加獲利。
text.en: HBM serves accelerator packages, server DRAM system memory, and NAND and enterprise SSDs storage. TrendForce’s September 30 research describes stronger server and enterprise SSD demand alongside cautious consumer purchasing. This background forecast does not establish universal profit growth.

text.zh: 前段要看蝕刻、沉積與設備電源，後段要看基板、接合、探針、燒機及可靠度。TrendForce 10 月 13 日列出台灣的 MPI、WinWay、Chroma 與 ASE 等測試或封裝角色；這是產業角色圖，未證實它們取得本案新訂單。
text.en: Upstream checks include etch, deposition and equipment power; downstream checks include substrates, bonding, probes, burn-in and reliability. TrendForce’s October 13 mapping identifies Taiwanese testing or assembly roles including MPI, WinWay, Chroma and ASE. It does not establish new orders for these events.

text.zh: 追蹤實際投產產能、良率、利用率及設備訂單。台積電對良率的說法屬公司陳述；AATT2 開幕資料沒有提供可核對的新增 HBM 產出。
text.en: Track operational capacity, yields, utilization and equipment orders. TSMC’s yield statements are company assertions; the opening release provides no independently checkable incremental HBM output.

text.zh: 台積電第三季美元營收 467.2 億美元，毛利率 66.4%；新台幣營收約 1.494 兆元、年增 50.9%，淨利 7,630.6 億元、年增 68.7%。不同貨幣成長率不可混用，這些是 10 月 15 日公布的公司實績。
text.en: TSMC reported Q3 revenue of US$46.72 billion and a 66.4% gross margin. Taiwan-dollar revenue was about NT$1.494 trillion, up 50.9% annually, and net income NT$763.06 billion, up 68.7%. Growth rates in different currencies must remain distinct. These results were released October 15.

text.zh: 分析：晶圓廠、封裝廠與設備商各自有認列時點。廠房開幕之後，還要看設備進場、客戶認證、試產與量產驗收；電源零組件供應商則要確認客戶何時拉貨、是否要求備庫存，以及驗收後多久付款。市場需求與可收回現金之間，還有交期與營運資金。
text.en: Analysis: fabs, packaging plants and tool vendors recognize revenue on different schedules. Openings must be followed by installation, qualification, trials and acceptance. Power-component suppliers need shipment calendars, inventory commitments and payment terms; delivery and working capital separate demand from cash.

text.zh: 分析：若封裝及 HBM 擴產已宣布，但設備認證或系統交付持續延後，就應檢查瓶頸是否轉移，而非直接追增備料。反過來，若利用率、客戶長約與設備拉貨一致改善，才較能支持增加工程或服務資源。這是決策情境，並非本期已觀察到的變化。
text.en: Analysis: announced packaging and HBM expansion alongside persistent qualification or system delays would warrant checking whether bottlenecks moved before adding inventory. Improving utilization, customer commitments and tool shipments together would better support more engineering or service resources. These are decision scenarios, not observed developments.

title.zh: OCP 台廠展示整機櫃、800 VDC 電源與液冷，量產驗收成為下一關
title.en: Taiwan vendors show racks, 800 VDC power and liquid cooling at OCP

summary.zh: 中央社 10 月 17 日整理 10 月 12 至 15 日於美國加州聖荷西舉辦的 OCP 展會：緯穎、華碩與勤誠等展示下一代伺服器或機櫃，台達電、光寶與康舒展示高壓直流電源及相關方案。台達電 10 月 15 日公司稿列出 800 VDC 電源櫃、備援與液冷產品，展示規格仍需與量產部署分開。
summary.en: CNA’s October 17 roundup of the October 12–15 OCP summit in San Jose, California describes server or rack exhibits from Wiwynn, ASUS and Chenbro, alongside power systems from Delta, Lite-On and AcBel. Delta’s October 15 release details 800 VDC power, backup and liquid cooling products. Exhibits are distinct from production deployments.

text.zh: OCP Global Summit 2026 於當地時間 10 月 12 至 15 日在美國加州聖荷西舉行，主場館為 San Jose McEnery Convention Center。本文追蹤台灣參展供應鏈；展會位於美國，不代表文中所有廠商的生產或投資地都在美國。
text.en: OCP Global Summit 2026 ran October 12–15 local time in San Jose, California, at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center. Coverage follows Taiwanese exhibitors; the event location does not imply that their production or investment is located in the United States.

label.zh: 從晶片走到可交付機櫃

text.zh: 晶片、HBM 與封裝完成後，仍需主機板、網路、機構、電源、備援、冷卻與整機測試。系統可用率及現場供電會影響客戶何時驗收；高算力規格只能回答其中一段。
text.en: Chips, HBM and packaging still need boards, networking, mechanics, power, backup, cooling and system testing. Availability and site power affect customer acceptance; compute specifications cover only part of delivery.

text.zh: 台達電、光寶與康舒的展示，讓高壓直流電源設計與整機整合成為可比較項目。本期未取得各廠同規格成本、效率曲線與量產訂單，無法判定市占變化；產品規格與客戶認證需要分開比較。
text.en: Delta, Lite-On and AcBel exhibits make high-voltage DC design and integration comparable topics. Comparable costs, efficiency curves and production orders are unavailable, preventing market-share conclusions; product specifications and customer qualifications need separate comparisons.

text.zh: 台達電列出 660 kW 電源櫃及 480 kW 備援規格，代表產品額定能力，不能當成每個客戶實際用電或已售出的容量。800 V 是架構電壓，也不等於節電百分比。
text.en: Delta lists a 660 kW power rack and 480 kW backup rating. These are product capabilities, not deployed customer consumption or sold capacity. The 800 V architecture is not an energy-saving percentage.

text.zh: 追蹤認證通過、量產起點、客戶驗收與現場效率。若電網接入、冷卻或機房工程落後，電源設計導入也可能延後轉成出貨。
text.en: Watch qualification, production start, acceptance and operating efficiency. Delays in grid connection, cooling or site construction can postpone shipments even after design selection.

label.en: Who pays and who owns integration?

text.zh: 分析：雲端客戶、系統廠、電源模組與機房工程商處在不同採購層。應逐案確認誰選規格、誰下單、誰負責韌體與冷卻介面，以及故障時由誰保固。模組規格領先不代表掌握整櫃議價權，供應商還要取得平台認證並能按時交貨。
text.en: Analysis: cloud buyers, system vendors, power-module suppliers and site contractors occupy different procurement layers. Establish who specifies, orders, integrates firmware and cooling interfaces, and warrants failures. Leading module specifications do not establish rack-level bargaining power; platform qualification and delivery still matter.

label.zh: 從售價看到毛利與現金
label.en: From selling price to margin and cash

text.zh: 分析：評估新架構時，要把研發與認證成本、備援設計、返修、現場支援及庫存放進同一張成本表。額定功率提高可能增加每櫃電源價值，也可能增加元件、測試與服務成本。本期沒有同口徑售價、毛利或部署資料，仍無法量化淨收益。
text.en: Analysis: assess engineering, qualification, redundancy, returns, field support and inventory in one cost model. Higher power ratings could increase content per rack and also component, testing and service costs. Comparable selling prices, margins and deployment data are unavailable, so net gains remain unquantified.

title.zh: 友達布局玻璃基板與光通訊零組件，2030 年純面板占比目標為 30%
title.en: AUO targets glass and optical components; pure-panel revenue share goal is 30% by 2030

summary.zh: 友達董事長彭双浪 10 月 17 日表示，公司在先進封裝將扮演零組件供應者，運用玻璃與 TGV 技術；與康寧合作的技術已有低軌衛星天線應用。MicroLED 光通訊與 CPO 的量產時間估計仍為兩至三年，屬公司展望。
summary.en: AUO chairman Paul Peng said on October 17 that the company would supply advanced-packaging components using glass and TGV expertise. Technology developed with Corning already has low-earth-orbit antenna applications. A two-to-three-year volume-production outlook for MicroLED optical communications and CPO remains a company forecast.

text.zh: 玻璃加工能力可延伸到不同零組件，但封裝用玻璃的可靠度、平整度與量產良率仍需客戶驗證。低軌衛星應用已有進展，不能直接當成半導體封裝已通過認證。
text.en: Glass processing can extend into new components, but packaging reliability, flatness and production yield require qualification. Progress in satellite applications does not establish semiconductor-packaging acceptance.

text.zh: 30% 是 2030 年純面板營收占比目標，並非營收下跌 30%。本期依中央社具名採訪，未取得逐字稿、客戶認證或新業務獲利資料，標為來源受限。
text.en: The 30% figure is a targeted revenue mix in 2030, not a 30% revenue decline. Coverage relies on CNA’s named interview; transcripts, customer qualification and profitability evidence were unavailable. Source-limited.

label.zh: 材料能力如何成為可交付產品？
label.en: How does materials expertise become a deliverable product?

text.zh: 分析：先比較玻璃通孔、加工與檢測等製程的認證要求，再看設備投資及量產交期。顯示器製程經驗提供技術起點，但客戶驗證、產品設計與失效分析仍決定新業務能否收費；公司目前的轉型目標，尚不能換算新材料的營收或毛利。
text.en: Analysis: compare qualification needs in through-glass vias, processing and inspection before evaluating equipment investment and schedules. Display expertise offers a starting point, while qualification, design and failure analysis determine commercial acceptance. Transition targets do not quantify new-material revenue or margins.

takeaway.zh: 分析：先辨識新材料製程使用哪些設備、是否增加電源控制要求，再決定工程投入。零組件轉型可能形成設備需求，現階段未有可量化的 電源供應商 訂單或資本支出影響。
takeaway.en: Analysis: identify the process tools and power-control requirements of new materials before allocating engineering. This transition could create equipment demand, but no quantified supplier orders or capex effect is established.

summary.en: NVIDIA announced RTX Spark Windows PCs on October 16, with ASUS, MSI and international PC brands using Grace CPUs and Blackwell GPUs. An executive told CNA that MediaTek contributed CPU design and that the platform uses CoWoS; demand and capacity assessments remain company statements.

metricLabel.zh: 公司公布的最高統一記憶體規格

text.zh: 本地 AI 電腦由用戶購買硬體，成本包含晶片、封裝、記憶體及通路；能否節省雲端費用取決於實際工作負載。統一記憶體容量不能直接當成 HBM 需求，本期沒有核實 HBM 用量。
text.en: Users buy local-AI hardware covering chips, packaging, memory and distribution. Cloud savings depend on workloads. Unified-memory capacity does not establish HBM demand; no HBM content is verified here.

text.zh: 公司強調可在本機執行 AI 工作，但尚無本期可核對的出貨、使用率或完整生命週期成本。以實際任務耗電與延遲驗證產品價值。
text.en: The company emphasizes local AI, but shipments, utilization and full lifecycle costs are not verified here. Test value using workload-level energy and latency.

text.en: Analysis: local economics depend on moving sustained, suitable workloads onto the device. Compare purchase, energy, maintenance, model updates and idle time against cloud usage actually displaced. These workload data are unavailable; memory specifications cannot establish a savings rate.

title.zh: 經濟部說明赴美園區由業者籌資，每座估 20 億至 40 億美元
title.en: Taiwan says planned U.S. parks would be privately funded at an estimated $2–4 billion each

summary.zh: 經濟部 10 月 16 日向中央社說明，將與電電公會推動海外產業園區，採業者出資、政府協助模式。龔明鑫專訪提及由德州起步、規劃不只一座；單一園區 20 億至 40 億美元是估算，土地取得細節尚未對外確認。
summary.en: Taiwan’s economics ministry told CNA on October 16 that it would work with TEEMA on privately funded overseas industrial parks. Minister Kung Ming-hsin described starting in Texas; the estimated $2–4 billion per park is a plan, with land details unconfirmed.

text.zh: 大型晶片與伺服器廠赴美後，仍需要基板、散熱與其他中小型供應商。園區共用基礎設施與在地服務可能分攤進入成本，但實際優勢須由租用率、物流成本與客戶訂單驗證。
text.en: Chip and server plants need substrate, cooling and other smaller suppliers. Shared infrastructure could spread entry costs; occupancy, logistics costs and customer orders must validate the advantage.

label.en: Where it sits in the value chain

text.zh: 零組件與材料供應商位於晶片製造、伺服器組裝之前，最終需求則來自雲端與企業客戶。分析上，共用園區可能降低個別廠商的行政與設施負擔，但客戶認證、良率、當地用工與交期仍須各自完成；入住園區不等於取得訂單。
text.en: Component and materials suppliers sit upstream of chipmaking and server assembly, with demand ultimately coming from cloud and enterprise buyers. Shared parks may reduce administrative and facility burdens, but qualification, yields, staffing and delivery still depend on each supplier; tenancy does not secure orders.

text.zh: 金額來自部長專訪與經濟部對媒體說明，尚未取得完整融資、預算或土地契約文件。不能當成政府已編列支出，或業者已全數承諾的資本。
text.en: The estimate comes from the minister and ministry statements reported by media. Full financing, budget and land documents were unavailable; it is neither appropriated government spending nor fully committed capital.

text.zh: 追蹤開發主體、融資結構、用地、入駐名單與動工日期；美方對貿易投資關係的回應，尚不足以證明特定園區已獲核准。
text.en: Watch the developer, funding structure, land, tenants and groundbreaking. U.S. comments on bilateral investment do not establish approval of a particular park.

text.zh: 分析：把在地工程、維修與庫存布局綁定已簽客戶需求，並比較當地製造成本與資金占用。園區規劃尚不足以支持 電源供應商 擴廠決策。
text.en: Analysis: tie local engineering, service and inventory to contracted customer demand, comparing manufacturing costs and capital tied up. Park plans alone do not justify power suppliers expansion.

title.zh: 中經院上修台灣全年成長預測至 12.16%，需分開看實績與展望
title.en: CIER raises Taiwan’s full-year growth forecast to 12.16%; distinguish results from projections

summary.zh: 中經院 10 月 16 日公布第四季預測，把 2026 年經濟成長率由 7 月的 10.35% 上修至 12.16%，提高 1.81 個百分點。預估內需貢獻 6.63 個百分點、國外淨需求貢獻 5.53 個百分點；全年數字仍是預測。
summary.en: CIER’s October 16 forecast raised 2026 growth from July’s 10.35% to 12.16%, an increase of 1.81 percentage points. Domestic demand is projected to contribute 6.63 points and net external demand 5.53; the full-year figure remains a forecast.

metricLabel.zh: 中經院 2026 年全年 GDP 成長預測

takeaway.zh: 這份預測的重點是 AI 硬體需求如何傳到投資與消費。分析時仍要分清：少數出口產業的強勁成長、整體 GDP，以及每個人的收入感受，三者不會等比例變動。
takeaway.en: The forecast connects AI hardware demand to investment and consumption. Export-industry growth, aggregate GDP and household income experiences need not move proportionately.

text.zh: 10.35% 與 12.16% 是同一年度在不同時間的預測，差額為 1.81 個百分點。第四季預估年增 8.20%，面對去年同期高基期；增速放緩本身不代表當季產出縮減。
text.en: The two figures are different vintages of the same-year forecast, separated by 1.81 percentage points. Fourth-quarter growth is projected at 8.20% against a high prior-year base; slower growth does not itself mean output contracts.

text.zh: 中經院把 AI 需求、企業擴產與國內投資列為動能。分析上，設備、工程與在地服務可能透過資本支出受益；但收益分布仍取決於訂單、薪資、進口投入與利潤留存，不能直接由總量推定。
text.en: CIER identifies AI demand, capacity expansion and investment as drivers. Analysis: equipment, construction and local services may benefit through capex, but distribution depends on orders, wages, imports and retained profits.

text.zh: 追蹤主計總處後續 GDP 實績、民間投資與消費是否符合假設，以及主要雲端客戶資本支出。中經院亦列出融資、地緣政治與 AI 資安等不確定性；預測不能替代已公布統計。
text.en: Watch official GDP releases, private investment, consumption and hyperscaler capex. CIER flags financing, geopolitics and AI security uncertainties; projections do not replace published outcomes.

text.zh: 分析：台灣投資展望可協助安排客戶拜訪與區域服務能力，但 GDP 預測不能直接換算 電源供應商 訂單。優先檢查設備客戶資本支出、拉貨及收款。
text.en: Analysis: Taiwan’s investment outlook can guide customer coverage and regional service planning, but GDP forecasts cannot be converted into supplier orders. Check equipment-customer capex, shipments and collections.

title.zh: 胡志明市要求釐清 AI 資料中心電價，投資模型面臨費率認定
title.en: Ho Chi Minh City seeks clarity on AI data-center power tariffs

summary.zh: TNGlobal 10 月 16 日報導，胡志明市工業區管理機關在 10 月 15 日經濟會議要求統一 AI 資料中心電價指引。所涉 AIC 與 KBC 計畫早於 3 月公布，總規劃金額 21 億美元；本次新增進展是電價問題，並非新宣布投資。
summary.en: TNGlobal reported October 16 that Ho Chi Minh City’s industrial-zone authority sought unified AI data-center power-tariff guidance at an October 15 meeting. The AIC–KBC project, with a planned $2.1 billion investment, was announced in March. The new development is tariff clarification, not a new investment announcement.

metricLabel.zh: 既有資料中心計畫金額

text.zh: 爭點是適用商業或製造業電價。較高電價可能改變營運成本、財務可行性及進度；本期沒有已定案費率、用電曲線或投資報酬模型，無法估算確切成本差額。
text.en: The issue is business versus manufacturing tariffs. Higher tariffs could affect costs, feasibility and timing. Final rates, load profiles and a financial model are unavailable, preventing a quantified cost difference.

text.zh: 追蹤主管機關正式費率分類、電力合約、融資及首期上線。本期依專業媒體報導，未取得 HEPZA 會議文件與最終行政決定，來源受限。
text.en: Track official tariff classification, power contracts, financing and first-phase commissioning. Original HEPZA meeting records and a final administrative decision were unavailable; source-limited.

label.zh: 整案與首期容量要分開
label.en: Separate the full project from phase one

text.zh: TNGlobal 報導所列首期規劃最高 50 MW，而 21 億美元是既有計畫的總投資描述；兩者時程與範圍未完整對齊。本期不以總金額除以首期容量估算每 MW 造價，也不把規劃容量當成已通電或已出租容量。
text.en: TNGlobal describes phase-one plans of up to 50 MW, while $2.1 billion refers to the previously announced overall project. Their scope and timing are not fully aligned. No per-MW construction cost is calculated from these figures, and planned capacity is not energized or leased capacity.

label.en: How do tariffs feed into procurement?

text.zh: 分析：費率認定會進入營運成本與客戶定價，若影響融資條件或開工時程，才可能再傳到電源、備援與冷卻設備的交貨。供應商應先查有沒有正式電力合約、確定的施工里程碑與驗收條件，避免把整案投資額當成可接單市場。
text.en: Analysis: tariff classification affects operating costs and customer pricing. Effects on financing or construction could then alter delivery of power, backup and cooling equipment. Suppliers should check power contracts, construction milestones and acceptance terms before treating overall investment as an addressable order pool.

text.zh: 分析：如果費率較預期高，投資方可能重算定價、使用率或分期規模；若分類問題獲解決，仍需看電力接入與客戶簽約。現有資料不足以預測哪種情境會發生，下一步是追正式費率與投資方更新。
text.en: Analysis: higher-than-expected tariffs could prompt revised pricing, utilization assumptions or phasing. A classification resolution would still need grid access and customers. Available evidence cannot predict either outcome; official rates and sponsor updates are the next tests.

sources.name: TNGlobal · 胡志明市電價爭點

takeaway.zh: 分析：先確認客戶取得的電力條件，再安排機櫃電源工程與交貨。節能、功率密度及可靠度仍有價值，但現有資料不足以估算 電源供應商 收入或投資回收。
takeaway.en: Analysis: confirm customer power terms before committing rack-power engineering and delivery. Efficiency, density and reliability matter, but available evidence cannot quantify supplier revenue or payback.

summary.en: CNA reported October 16 that a semiconductor recruitment event organized by Selangor-linked institutions at KLCC in Kuala Lumpur offered over 1,500 vacancies across design, software, firmware, process, equipment and facilities. An official reported 20 companies and 409 engineers in two design parks, complementing Penang manufacturing, assembly and testing.

title.en: Regional background: Vietnam nine-month realized FDI rises 12.1%; distinguish registrations from execution

summary.zh: 越南政府新聞網 10 月 3 日公布的前三季資料顯示，FDI 實現額估 210.7 億美元、年增 12.1%，總註冊外資為 503.6 億美元、年增 76.4%。這是本期新增的區域背景，資料截至 9 月 30 日，並非 10 月 17 日的新統計。
summary.en: Vietnam’s government news portal reported October 3 that estimated realized FDI reached $21.07 billion in the first nine months, up 12.1% yearly, while total registered foreign investment reached $50.36 billion, up 76.4%. This is regional background through September 30, not a new October 17 release.

metricLabel.zh: 前三季 FDI 實現額年增

text.zh: 註冊額包括新案、增資與股權交易，實現額是不同口徑，不能相加。兩者也未對應同一批投資案，不能以 210.7 除以 503.6 當成本期計畫完成率；本期來源未列可比基期金額。
text.en: Registrations include new projects, additions and equity transactions, while realized FDI uses a different scope. They cannot be added, and the ratio is not a project completion rate because cohorts differ. Comparable prior-year amounts are not provided.

text.zh: 追蹤製造業投資分項及實際設備採購。本期以越南政府統計轉述與專業媒體交叉核對，實現額仍屬估計，可在後續統計修訂。
text.en: Track manufacturing breakdowns and actual equipment purchases. Official reporting is cross-checked with specialist media; realized FDI remains an estimate subject to revision.

label.zh: 製造業分項的分母是什麼？

text.zh: VnEconomy 10 月 4 日轉述，新案與增資合計中，製造加工業為 218.2 億美元、占 50.3%；新加坡則是新註冊外資最大來源，金額 92.6 億美元、占 31.7%。前者分母是新案加增資，後者是新註冊資本，均不能套用到 503.6 億美元總註冊額。這些分項尚未核對官方原始明細表，屬來源受限。
text.en: VnEconomy reported October 4 that manufacturing and processing received $21.82 billion, or 50.3% of new and additional registrations. Singapore supplied $9.26 billion, or 31.7% of newly registered capital. Neither percentage uses the $50.36 billion total-registration denominator. These breakdowns have not been checked against original official tables and are source-limited.

title.zh: 背景追蹤：工廠 AI 合作延伸到檢測、測試與數位分身，收益仍待驗收
title.en: Background follow-up: factory AI reaches inspection, testing and digital twins; benefits need acceptance

summary.zh: NVIDIA 10 月 14 日公司稿列出 KLA 檢測、Advantest 測試，以及鴻海、FANUC 等工廠 AI 合作。本期把它作為台灣供應鏈與終端工廠的背景追蹤；各場域地點、全面量產時程與全廠投資報酬未完整公開。
summary.en: NVIDIA’s October 14 release describes KLA inspection, Advantest testing and factory AI collaborations involving Foxconn and FANUC. This is background for Taiwan-linked supply chains and end-use factories; deployment sites, full production schedules and plant-wide ROI are not fully disclosed.

metricLabel.zh: 觀察導入進度，尚無可核對的全廠收益
metricLabel.en: Track adoption; no verified plant-wide returns

takeaway.zh: 分析：設備與軟體能否改善單一工序，和整廠能否增加可交付產出，是兩個驗收問題。採購前應建立基期，追到良率、停機、返工及現金回收。
takeaway.en: Analysis: improving one process and increasing deliverable plant output are separate acceptance tests. Establish a baseline before procurement and track yield, downtime, rework and cash recovery.

text.zh: 晶片及伺服器提供算力，檢測與測試設備產生資料，工廠再把模型接到工程、排程或現場流程。合作名單提供可能的整合介面，尚不足以證明所有設備已串接，或同一套方法可複製到每座工廠。
text.en: Chips and servers provide compute, inspection and test tools generate data, and factories connect models to engineering, scheduling or operations. Partnership lists indicate possible interfaces; they do not establish complete integration or transferability across plants.

label.en: What does a factory pay to improve?

text.zh: 分析：工廠重視的是可驗收的品質、交期與成本改善。評估時，要把運算硬體、資料整理、軟體整合、停機導入及維護一起算入投入，再檢查省下的成本是否能持續。本期未公開合約計價或量化收益，不能推算供應商收入。
text.en: Analysis: factories need accepted improvements in quality, delivery and cost. Include compute, data preparation, integration, installation downtime and maintenance in the investment, then test whether savings persist. Pricing and quantified benefits are undisclosed, preventing supplier-revenue estimates.

text.zh: 分析：先定義改善前的期間、產品組合及產量，再對照誤判、重工、良率、非計畫停機與每件良品成本。模型運算較快，可能只改善流程中的一小段；應確認瓶頸是否移動，以及改善是否真的增加出貨或減少支出。
text.en: Analysis: define the baseline period, mix and output, then compare false decisions, rework, yield, unplanned downtime and cost per good unit. Faster model execution may affect only one step; test whether bottlenecks move and whether shipments or spending actually improve.

text.zh: 追蹤具名工廠、試點轉量產的驗收文件、同條件前後數據及持續維護成本。公司發布證實合作與產品方向，效能及收益仍須使用者或獨立資料驗證。
text.en: Track named plants, pilot-to-production acceptance, comparable before-and-after data and recurring maintenance costs. The release establishes company-announced collaboration and direction; users or independent evidence must validate performance and benefits.

impact.en: Analysis: improving one process and increasing deliverable plant output are separate acceptance tests. Establish a baseline before procurement and track yield, downtime, rework and cash recovery.

horizon.zh: 試點至量產驗收，時程未完整公開
horizon.en: Pilot to production acceptance; full timing undisclosed

action.zh: 先建立基期，再看良品成本與現金回收
action.en: Establish baseline, then assess cost per good unit and cash recovery

checkpoint.zh: 具名工廠、同條件數據、驗收與維護成本
checkpoint.en: Named plants, comparable data, acceptance and maintenance cost

location.zh: 全球合作發布；各工廠實際導入地點未完整披露
location.en: Global collaboration announcement; individual factory deployment sites are not fully disclosed

text.zh: 本週追蹤 CoWoS 與美光 HBM 後段，設備拉貨與實際產能比開幕更能驗證需求。
text.en: Track CoWoS and Micron HBM backend progress through tool shipments and operational capacity.

text.zh: OCP 展示整機櫃、800 VDC 與液冷，電源供應商 需比較認證、效率及量產交付。
text.en: OCP rack, 800 VDC and cooling exhibits shift attention to qualification, efficiency and production delivery.

text.zh: 工廠 AI 要追到品質、停機與良品成本，合作名單尚不足以證明收益。
text.en: Factory AI needs quality, downtime and cost-per-good-unit evidence; partnership lists do not establish returns.

text.zh: 越南資料中心電價認定未明，既有 21 億美元計畫需要重看營運假設。
text.en: Vietnam’s unresolved data-center tariff classification affects assumptions for an existing $2.1 billion plan.

text.zh: 馬來西亞招募涵蓋設計、封測與廠務，區域布局也要驗證現場工程能力。
text.en: Malaysia recruits across design, backend and facilities roles, making field capability a regional planning factor.

question.zh: HBM 需求如何傳到設備電源？
question.en: How does HBM demand reach equipment power?

text.zh: 把晶圓、封裝、測試的認證與拉貨拆開，才能辨識可服務需求及交付限制。
text.en: Separate fabrication, assembly and test qualifications and shipments to identify serviceable demand and delivery constraints.

question.zh: 800 VDC 會改變誰的議價能力？
question.en: Whose bargaining power changes with 800 VDC?

text.zh: 比較模組、整機整合與現場驗收責任，理解電源規格如何轉成收入與成本。
text.en: Compare modules, integration and site acceptance to understand revenue and cost conversion.

question.zh: 電價怎麼改變資料中心的投資算式？
question.en: How do tariffs change data-center economics?

text.zh: 把既有投資、電價分類與實際負載分開，才能檢查營運成本及設備交付風險。
text.en: Separate existing investment, tariff classification and actual loads to assess operating costs and delivery risk.

title.zh: 供應鏈要追到終端工廠
title.en: Follow the chain into end-use factories

text.zh: 由晶圓、封裝與機櫃往下看，終端工廠還要驗證檢測、測試與流程整合是否改善良品成本。第十則以 10 月 14 日合作發布補上使用端，屬背景追蹤；本期並未核實全廠投資報酬。
text.en: Beyond fabrication, packaging and racks, factories need to test whether inspection, testing and integration improve cost per good unit. Story ten follows the October 14 collaboration as adoption background, with no verified plant-wide ROI.

title.zh: 目前較像技術轉換，需求循環仍需分層
title.en: Technology transition with distinct demand cycles

text.zh: 高壓供電、HBM 與新封裝顯示技術架構變化；消費記憶體、終端 PC 及東南亞組裝則仍需實際銷售與庫存佐證。若設備拉貨、系統利用率或客戶資本支出轉弱，就需下修需求延續的判斷，不能只靠新品或展覽。
text.en: High-voltage power, HBM and packaging signal architectural change. Consumer memory, PCs and Southeast Asian assembly still require sales and inventory evidence. Weaker tool shipments, system utilization or customer capex would challenge sustained-demand assumptions.

verificationNote.zh: 本期聚焦台灣與東南亞。CoWoS、美光、10 月 14 日工廠 AI 合作及越南 10 月 3 日 FDI 資料明列為追蹤或背景。展示規格、公司目標、園區估算與 GDP 預測均非已完成訂單。友達與馬來西亞園區數字依具名採訪；胡志明市電價缺原始會議文件及最終費率，越南製造業及資金來源分項未核對官方原表，這些部分屬來源受限。營運影響與情境推演為編輯分析，未披露的訂單、基期與影響金額保持未知。 活動地點依主辦資料補充；MSRD 招募起日存在 10/14 與 10/15 兩種主辦頁記載，KLCC 場館則一致。
verificationNote.en: Focused on Taiwan and Southeast Asia. CoWoS, Micron, October 14 factory AI collaboration and Vietnam’s October 3 FDI figures are follow-ups or background. Ratings, targets, park estimates and GDP forecasts are not completed orders. AUO and Malaysian park figures rely on named interviews. Original Ho Chi Minh City records and final tariffs are unavailable; Vietnam manufacturing and investor-origin breakdowns lack original-table verification. These portions are source-limited. Operating impacts and scenarios are editorial analysis; undisclosed orders, bases and financial effects remain unknown. Event locations use organizer sources. MSRD organizer pages differ on an October 14 or 15 start date but agree on KLCC.
